finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full crash.**

At `02:14:07` Redis dropped (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). The app fell back to direct store reads, which triggered cache miss storms and 5000ms timeouts across `api`, `worker-1`, `worker-2`, `scheduler`.

Reconnect attempts kept failing every ~2 minutes, attempts 7 through 12, all `ECONNREFUSED`, through `02:31:26`. Meanwhile the request queue climbed from 52 to 568, way past the max of 500.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` and crashed. At `02:31:52` the supervisor killed the whole process group: `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`. That's the end of the log.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` went unreachable, and add backpressure so queue depth can't run past 500 unbounded.
